'''SeeVee''' or '''C-V''' was an [[ASP-7 labor droid/Legends|ASP-7 labor droid]] owned by the [[Smuggler/Legends|smuggler]] [[Platt Okeefe/Legends|Platt Okeefe]]. The droid served her onboard the [[Last Chance (YT-1300 light freighter)/Legends|''Last Chance'']].

==History==
Like many ASP series droids, he was only capable of answering either "affirmative" or "negative". The droid often got on Okeefe's nerves and annoyed many customs inspectors; sometimes with positive results, sometimes negative.<ref name="psg">''[[Platt's Smugglers Guide]]''</ref>

At one point while smuggling Imperial-issue heavy [[Blaster/Legends|blasters]], [[TIE/ln space superiority starfighter/Legends|TIE/LN starfighters]] shot down [[Platt Okeefe/Legends|Platt Okeefe]] over the planet Dorajan. Crashing in the jungles, Okeefe had to work running repairs on her ship, aided only by SeeVee. However the droid was a cheap model with slow processing speed and proved little practical help. Nevertheless, Okeefe managed the repairs and evaded the Imperial picket.<ref name="sesb">''[[Shadows of the Empire Sourcebook]]''</ref>

Later, SeeVee was present on the ''Last Chance'' when a [[Brentaalan]] boy, [[Darrik]], tried to stowaway. The droid traveled with Okeefe and Darrik to the planet [[Bespin/Legends|Bespin]]. There, the [[Bounty hunter/Legends|bounty hunter]] [[Beylyssa]] infiltrated the ''Last Chance'' disguised as a [[Bespin Wing Guard/Legends|Bespin Wing Guard]]. In her frustration at not finding Okeefe there, she destroyed the droid, knocking its head off with a powerful kick.<ref name="idc" />
